In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a '''skirmish''' took place in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A group of unreconstructed Imperials on their way to join the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] were attacked by a group of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]], and their [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] were completely annihilated. When the forces of the [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Urias Xhaxin]] arrived from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], intending to pick off the Imperials themselves, they were attacked by the coralskippers and forced to flee. Xhaxin was later [[Second skirmish in the Outer Rim|picked up]] by the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet's]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] and was pumped for information on the coralskippers, which were still largely unknown to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
